notes: cv2.imdecode(array, IMREAD_UNCHANGED), cv2.resize(image, (width, height), interpolation=INTER_AREA), cv2.imencode('.png', ...); returns the encoded numpy array. INTER_AREA is the filter OpenCV documents for shrinking: its default (bilinear) and its Lanczos4 look at only a few neighbouring pixels and would not average the area a thumbnail pixel covers.
details: Lanczos named for the other entries is not used here because cv2.INTER_LANCZOS4 uses a fixed 8 by 8 neighbourhood without widening the kernel when shrinking.
